real: Su-34 Fullback with FAB-500 + UMPK glide kits; R-73 on the wingtip rails
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p25_new): an Su-34 look, a Flanker planform with a broad flat nose and side-by-side cockpit, twin tails, two big glide bombs with UMPK wings under the wings; 9.3 x 5.9 x 2.4 m (about 0.42 x the real aircraft); team bands on the fins; no real insignia.

features.feature: the fuselage (Team) with the broad flat platypus nose and chines, the tail stinger with its radar
the wide canopy over the side-by-side seats, its frames
canards, the long root extensions and the Flanker wing with tip rails and lights
two engine nacelles with the tunnel between, intakes with ramps under the root extensions
nozzles with petals and the afterburner glow
twin fins with rudders and Team bands, the tailplanes, two ventral fins
two FAB-500 with UMPK glide wing kits and tail fins on heavy pylons, R-73 on the wingtip rails
the centre-line rack under the tunnel (the main weapon)
two rows of flare dispensers a side on the nacelles (Mount_Flare_* from the wrapper)
the refuelling probe, pitot, blade antennas, lights

budget.note: over the maximum is information only

wreck: the wrapper adds Part_wing (the left wing) for the breakup
faction_style: military aircraft (both factions); jet rule: no insets
